Notes: 4 x dual op-amp packages (U1-U4); each drawn as two sections
2 x dual-gang 20k linear pots (VR1, VR2); wired as rheostats
Sets the board's input impedance - see docs/design-review.md

Output terminal block to the treble amplifier

Test points - optional, omit with R10/R11 and R23/R24
